agents.name: Date & Story Queue
agents.role: Calculate 200/100/75-year windows, create daily research slate, cluster duplicate stories.

agents.name: Major Press Research
agents.role: Find and rank national/major metropolitan headlines and original issue links.

agents.name: Black & Community Press Research
agents.role: Search Black Press and broader Community Press Voices archives for same-day coverage and parallel leads.

agents.name: Regional / Local Research
agents.role: Find geographically relevant reporting and identify city/state context.

agents.name: Verification + Discrepancy
agents.role: Cross-check dates, attributions, OCR, translations and rights flags; route unresolved conflicts to human review.

agents.name: Publishing + Social
agents.role: Assemble verified website cards and platform-native packages for YouTube, Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, X and Threads.

automation_rule: If source and verification checks agree, continue automatically. If material discrepancies remain after secondary checks, HOLD and request human resolution.
